turns.agent:
I couldn't make the poster. Magic Hour turned the request down because your account doesn't have enough credits, so nothing was created and nothing was charged.

This was already the cheapest setup on the free plan: the flux-2-klein model at 640px, about 5 credits per image. A different model or setting won't fix it.

**To go ahead:** add credits to your Magic Hour account by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan, then tell me and I'll run it again. It's all ready to go:
- **Shape:** tall portrait (9:16)
- **Words:** only "NIGHT MARKET" as the main heading and "SATURDAY 6–10 PM" underneath
- **Look:** a bright illustration of food stalls under glowing red and orange lanterns against a deep blue night sky

AI image models sometimes get letters wrong. When it's done, check that the words are spelled exactly right, and I can run it again if they're off.
